title: FOT 2025 | Dallas Texas
segments: Hey, shalom is most high in Christ
blesses. Captain Lewell, we are in
Dallas, Texas for the feast of
tabernacles. All praise to the most
high. There's a lot of spiritual
meanings behind keeping the feast of
tabernacles other than just bringing
your U-Hauls and your trailers and your
RVs and all that. This is the reminder
that the Lord gave us every year when
you read Leviticus chapter 23 starting
at verse 34 of the Lord dwelling in our
tabernacles,
his spirit dwelling within us because he
said that he would dwell with us. When
you read the book of John, this is also
a reminder of us being in these earthly
tabernacles right now. But if we stay in
the spirit, we stay in the faith, we
stay in the fight, we endure to the end,
we going to be clothed upon with our
heavenly tabernacles, them new bodies,
them heavenly bodies that the Lord
promised us are waiting for us in the
heavens. But we got to transition. We
got to give our bodies as a living
sacrifice for our God, our king, our
savior, Jesus the Christ. We have to be
a living a sacrifice for our nation, for
our people. These are all the things
that the Lord has given us the
understanding thereof during the feast
of tabernacles for us to be in
remembrance of. Also, stop murmuring,
stop complaining. Guess what? Bugs live
outside. Snakes, scorpions, spiders, we
we in their house.
You know, so stop all that complaining
and it's hot. Yeah, it's hot. Hell, I
did a little bit of complaining myself.
It's hot. It was 102 degrees just a day
ago here in Texas. So, I get it. But the
Lord is is setting us up for these last
days to be able to prepare ourselves,
prepare our minds, our souls, our
spirits, prepare us for the tribulation
to come. Prepare us for the persecution
to come. Cuz it's coming. It ain't a
matter of if, it's a matter of when. So,
Israel, y'all stay in the spirit. Stay
in the fight. Stay in these
commandments. Stay in the scriptures.
Stay in the spirit. Shalom.
